governingRule: The generic Studio schema remains authoritative. Bird Oracle fields are mapped into generic fields and retained losslessly under a namespaced custom payload.

genericCardMapping.title: title
genericCardMapping.status: status mapped to outline, draft, review or complete
genericCardMapping.content.rights_status: image status, source, rights, credit and type

losslessPayload: content.custom.aotearoa_bird_oracle stores parsed front matter, exact body Markdown, exact raw Markdown, source path and SHA-256 checksum.
duplicateProtection: studio_import_records has one row per project, source system and source key. Matching checksums are skipped; changed checksums update the existing target and create a normal Studio version.
dryRun: Every source file is counted, checksummed, mapped or reported as an exception before any database write.
